### Tin tức về Crypto mới nhất:

1. **[Crypto Is Entering Its Industrial Age - Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/crypto-is-entering-its-industrial-age-12254687)**  
   Bài viết thảo luận về sự chuyển mình của crypto từ việc phát triển các giao thức mới sang việc các tổ chức đang tìm cách sở hữu chuỗi cung ứng công nghiệp sản xuất và dịch vụ cho các tài sản số.

2. **[Crypto Firms Still Undervalue Operational Excellence - Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/crypto-firms-still-undervalue-operational-excellence-12256019)**

3. **[IMF issues crypto asset warning to Brazil - Finextra Research](https://www.finextra.com/newsarticle/48156/imf-issues-crypto-asset-warning-to-brazil)**  
   Quỹ Tiền tệ Quốc tế (IMF) đã kêu gọi giám sát chặt chẽ thị trường tài sản số đang phát triển nhanh chóng của Brazil.

4. **[Bitcoin’s breakdown puts Ethereum, Breadth and ALT risk back in focus - KITCO](https://www.kitco.com/opinion/2026-07-28/bitcoins-breakdown-puts-ethereum-breadth-and-alt-risk-back-focus)**

5. **[Saudi Arabia intercepts drones targeting oil facilities as geopolitical risk reprices energy markets - Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/saudi-arabia-drone-oil-facilities-crypto-impact/)**  
   Các cuộc tấn công bằng drone vào cơ sở hạ tầng dầu mỏ của Ả Rập Saudi đã tạo ra sự không chắc chắn mới cho thị trường năng lượng, ảnh hưởng đến các tài sản rủi ro bao gồm cả crypto.

items.title: Crypto Is Entering Its Industrial Age - Newsweek
items.summary: For most of crypto’s history, success depended on inventing new protocols and convincing users that one blockchain's technical architecture was superior to another's. The first wave of institutional adoption largely consisted of investors buying raw commodities (Bitcoin as digital gold, Ether as programmable money), but the second, more consequential phase, is seeing institutions working to own the industrial supply chain that produces and services these commodities. The Industrialization of Crypto In crypto's early years, launching a blockchain with a novel consensus mechanism or virtual machine could create enormous value. The New Competitive Landscape Of course, the standardization of outputs leads to the compression of margins. Building Crypto’s Industrial Supply Chain The most valuable crypto businesses, far from being standalone software products, are now turning into sophisticated operational systems. ## **The Industrialization of Crypto**. In crypto's early years, launching a blockchain with a novel consensus mechanism or virtual machine could create enormous value. Of course, the standardization of outputs leads to the compression of margins.

items.title: Crypto Firms Still Undervalue Operational Excellence - Newsweek
items.summary: But after a decade at the helm of digital asset infrastructure companies, one lesson stands out to me: technology alone does not build enduring companies. My responsibility isn't to make everyone more like me; it's to build an organization where those different strengths complement one another while staying aligned around the same long-term direction. So I have spent years in teams building infrastructure for enterprises rather than consumers, and that experience has fundamentally shaped how we think about the industry. When dealing with enterprises, sales move slower, trust takes longer to earn, and customers evaluate you based on operational capability and whether you can consistently deliver results. Much of crypto still operates according to a technology-first mindset—building products because new capabilities have become possible—but it’s wiser to reverse that process. Crypto Is Entering Its Industrial Age. When dealing with enterprises, sales move slower, trust takes longer to earn, and customers evaluate you based on operational capability and whether you can consistently deliver results.

items.title: IMF issues crypto asset warning to Brazil - Finextra Research
items.summary: News and resources on digital currencies, crypto assets and crypto exchanges worldwide. This content has been selected, created and edited by the Finextra editorial team based upon its relevance and interest to our community. # IMF issues crypto asset warning to Brazil. The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has called for closer oversight of Brazil's rapidly developing digital assets market. The call was included in the IMF's Financial System Stability Assessment. While the report acknowledged the role that stablecoins have played in the development of Brazil's digital assets market, it also noted that stablecoin purchases are two to three tiems more sensitive to global shocks than traditional portfolio investments. “The crypto-asset market in Brazil is large and fast-growing, and increasingly interconnected with the traditional financial system,” stated the report. The IMF also recognised that Brazil's central bank, the Banco Central do Brasil, has taken steps to regulate the digital assets market and the providers working in the sector. ### Download Finextra News.

items.summary: # Bitcoin’s breakdown puts Ethereum, Breadth and ALT risk back in focus. Bitcoin’s failure to sustain its recent higher-low structure has shifted the daily market update toward downside risk. Ethereum has not yet completed the same structural break, but its momentum warning is clear, while crypto breadth, the dollar and multiple ALT charts point to a more defensive backdrop. *Bitcoin chart showing a break below recent higher-low structure*. ## Ethereum has a warning signal but not full bearish confirmation. *Ethereum chart inside the Cloud with RSI support broken*. Ethereum remains inside its Cloud and therefore has not yet completed the structural shift described for Bitcoin. The source treats a bearish OBV cross and a move below the Cloud as the additional confirmation needed for the downside case, keeping the current read conditional rather than absolute. *Crypto market breadth chart moving below the Cloud*. Bitcoin dominance is declining, but the source interprets that as selling into the dip rather than an automatic bullish signal for alternative assets.

items.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts drones targeting oil facilities as geopolitical risk reprices energy markets - Crypto Briefing
items.summary: # Saudi Arabia intercepts drones targeting oil facilities as geopolitical risk reprices energy markets. Iran-backed militia drone attacks on Eastern Province oil infrastructure add fresh uncertainty to global crude markets, with ripple effects across risk assets including crypto. Saudi Arabia’s air defenses shot down multiple drones aimed at oil facilities in the Eastern Province on July 27, with the kingdom’s defense ministry pinning the attacks on Iran-supported militias operating out of Iraqi territory. ## What happened and who’s claiming what. Turki Al-Maliki categorized the drone strikes as acts of terrorism, directly attributing them to Iran-backed groups launching from Iraqi soil. Separately, Yemen’s Houthi movement claimed responsibility for drone strikes targeting Saudi crude oil transportation infrastructure, specifically along the East-West pipeline. The Houthis framed their attacks as retaliation for alleged Saudi drone incursions into Yemeni territory. Iraq’s government responded by ordering an investigation into whether its territory was being used as a launchpad for attacks on Saudi infrastructure.

items.title: 5U AI scales up new digital workforce platform - American Journal of Transportation
items.summary: “We are not building another chatbot that answers questions and disappears, we are building AI Workers that understand freight operations, carry out the work, and capture the reasoning behind every decision, so teams can scale their knowledge as well as their capacity.”. 5U AI works inside existing freight systems and uses multi-agent AI trained for logistics workflows, including the complex exceptions and manual decisions that make forwarding operations difficult to automate with generic AI tools or legacy automation. The company is already live with forwarders and carriers across Europe, including with TCI International Logistics, where its AI Workers are being used across air and ocean freight operations. 5U AI is growing its team as part of the scale-up, with plans to hire across product, engineering, operations, commercial, and customer functions. “AI is one of the most exciting developments logistics has seen for a generation, but its value will depend on people who understand the industry and want to build practical tools that solve real operational problems,” said Abik.

items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

items.title: 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development' - Business Insider
items.summary: # Over 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'. Senior officials at some of the nation's leading AI companies say it's time for the federal government to find a way to put the brakes on AI development if it's needed. "We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," reads an open letter signed by more than 1,100 AI workers from companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. The letter zeroes in on "automated AI development," which refers to when AI will be capable of developing itself, something the industry calls "Recursive Self-Improvement." Anthropic has shared that its Claude models are quickly approaching that threshold. Look out for an alert in your inbox the next time a new story is published!

items.title: HKT unveils self-developed AI platform HKT.AI One-stop hub for global AI resources, advancing "AI for All" in Hong Kong - Voice of Alexandria
items.summary: # HKT unveils self-developed AI platform HKT.AI One-stop hub for global AI resources, advancing "AI for All" in Hong Kong. HONG KONG SAR - Media OutReach Newswire - 28 July 2026 - HKT announces the launch of HKT.AI, a one-stop, integrated AI platform that enables businesses and individual customers to access a broad suite of prominent global AI resources through a single and intuitive interface. The platform aims to accelerate the mass adoption of AI in Hong Kong, especially in empowering SMEs in their digital transformation, and advance the vision of "AI for All.". HKT.AI aggregates a wide range of Chinese Mainland-based and global AI resources, enabling businesses and individuals to seamlessly access and switch across specialised applications and tools on a single platform to meet diverse work and everyday needs.
